title: Remote code execution through AVIF image optimization
reason: Only reachable when Astro's Sharp image service optimizes an untrusted AVIF. This app never calls Sharp, uses no astro:assets or <Image>, stores verification uploads in R2 unprocessed, and Sharp cannot run inside a Cloudflare Worker; Sharp is a build-time dependency only. Fix requires Astro 7.2.8+ (we are on 5.x); the Astro 7 upgrade is tracked as its own task.
